title.narrative: Percentage of PHCCs and hospitals that have signed Performance-based Contracts for service quality improvement

comment.narrative:
Target exceeded. In total, contracts have been signed with 425 healthcare facilities from 502 (84%), of which 308 are primary healthcare centers and 117 are hospital units.
A Ministerial Order on PHCCs (No. 7473-L, dated December 3, 2025) has been approved. The Order includes 36 performance based indicators, 11 of which have been identified by the MoH as quality indicators. These indicators remain under discussion with ADB, WB, WHO, and MoH counterparts.
In addition, another Ministerial Order (No 153-N, 08/12/2025) has been approved, introducing 15 quality indicators for hospitals.

People receiving quality health, nutrition, and population services

target.value: To be determined after WB guidelines are available

comment.narrative:
Closing target to be defined during restructuring based on updated WB guidelines. This is a World Bank Corporate Results Indicator (CRI), and the methodology was not determined during program preparation. Therefore, the actual results are reported as of May 2026.
The indicator is calculated based on the catchment area population, using the total population of Armenia and the percentage of PHCCs and hospitals that have signed Performance-Based Contracts for service quality improvement. The conversion factor applied is 1/3.78 (26%).
The total population of Armenia as of January 1, 2026, is 3,096,900. Accordingly:
Actual result: 3,096,900 × 84% × 26% = 676,363
